sekcje: Drug Levels and Effects > Summary of Use during Lactation

No information is available on the clinical use of sparsentan during breastfeeding. The manufacturer recommends that breastfeeding be discontinued during sparsentan therapy because of potential adverse effects in the infant such as hypotension.
